meaning_fixes.reason: Font has no native-size lowercase j (project constraint); reworded imperative 待ちなさいよ without adding or dropping meaning.
Lowercase-j font constraint; 'exactly' preserves the same emphatic force as 何者だ ('just what/who are you').

checked_decisions.finding: 'こいつ' addressee shift from Eureka to an unnamed third party kept as neutral 'This one's the leader?'; no identity supplied beyond source, correct call.

'例のガンダム' kept generic as 'the famous Gundam' rather than naming a specific unit (e.g. Gundam X); no in-scene source or context settles which Gundam, so no identity was invented. 'Famous' is an interpretive gloss on 例の ('that certain/aforementioned') rather than a literal match, but does not misstate anything the source claims.

'兄さん…何を考えている…？' kept as a bare, unattributed 'Brother... what are you thinking...?'. Holland and Dewey are documented siblings in glossary.json (char.holland_novak / char.dewey), so the inference in the translator's note is reasonable, but correctly not written into the visible text since the table does not tag a speaker here.

左下、ベントロールに被弾！ラーダー脱落、操舵効率二割低下！ rendered 'Hit on the lower left Vent Roll!\nRudder's gone, steering efficiency down 20 percent!'. Both ベントロール and ラーダー are unattested in the glossary or an English wiki search; 'Rudder' is a functional reading justified by the paired steering-efficiency clause, not a confirmed spelling. Kept as drafted; no better-supported alternative found.

オーバーマンバトル rendered 'Overman battle', borrowing the established King Gainer-side term 'Overman' (this crossover project already uses 'Overman'/'King Gainer' per terms_028.json and unit_names_014_b.json) for a compound with no direct Eureka Seven-side attestation. Reasonable given the absence of a better source; kept as drafted. Confirmed the referenced proposals file exists at work/translation/en/dialogue/batch_03883_glossary_proposals.json (not under work/glossary, which is why an initial glossary-only search missed it) and correctly logs all three unattested terms (Vent Roll, Rudder, Overman battle) for orchestrator review.
Pronoun/identity handling re-checked against batch_03803's review of the same list (shared scene): consistent, no identity or gender invented beyond source.

uncertainties.issue: 'the famous Gundam' is a readable but interpretive gloss on 例の ('that [aforementioned] one'); an equally valid rendering would be 'that Gundam I mentioned' or similar. Left as drafted since no identity is invented either way.

ベルクトの部隊が狙うことは十分に考えられる ('it's quite conceivable Berkt's unit would target it') rendered 'it's entirely possible Berkt's unit will move to seize it.' 'Seize' narrows 狙う (target/aim for) to a specific intent (capture) not explicit in the source; contextually plausible (Shin Dragon is a prize mecha) but an interpretive strengthening, not a literal match. Left as drafted, meaning direction unchanged.
